title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on the Application of the Subject of Crimes of Dereliction of Duty in Chapter IX of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en:
The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, based on circumstances encountered in judicial practice, discussed the application of the subject of the crime of dereliction of duty under Chapter IX of the Criminal Law, and provides the following interpretation:
Any person who engages in public affairs in an organization that exercises state administrative powers in accordance with laws and regulations, or any person who engages in public affairs in an organization entrusted by a state organ to exercise the powers of a state organ on its behalf, or any person who, though not included in the staffing of a state organ, engages in public affairs in a state organ and, when exercising the powers of a state organ on its behalf, commits an act of dereliction of duty that constitutes a crime, shall be investigated for criminal liability in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law on the crime of dereliction of duty.
This is hereby announced.
